overall_goal: Check the pudding in the oven and serve it with cream

goals.description: Turn off the timer and check if the pudding is done
goals.rationale: The person turns off their phone timer, puts on oven gloves, opens the oven, and uses a knife to test the pudding's doneness.

goals.description: Serve the pudding with cream and taste it
goals.rationale: The person places the hot ramekin on the counter, tastes some excess chocolate, pours double cream over the pudding, and prepares the plate for eating.
